purpose: Teach: マッチ/アホ/佐々木/岐阜/さぁ/たまる/珠/うめ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、デートのマッチングアプリ使ってんだろ
lines.en: So you're really using one of those dating apps, huh?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a sharp edge. Fast attack on the first word. Conspiratorial laugh underneath. Leans in slightly — enjoying having caught him at something. Light, teasing, not mean.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストでアホみたいな間違いしたな、桜
lines.en: You really tanked that test question, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quick deflection — turning it back on her before she can press. Slight smile in the voice. Not defensive, just evading. The rhythm of two people who've done this dance before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、佐々木先生、お前の評価高いぞ
lines.en: Wait — Sasaki-sensei actually praised you? That's a first.
lines.style: Genuine surprise breaking through the surface. Eyebrow-raising tone. Warm underneath the ribbing. A beat of actual respect showing through before the teasing covers it again.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で岐阜行くらしいな、桜
lines.en: Heard you're going to Gifu for the school trip. That should be interesting.
lines.style: Casual curiosity. Softer attack than before. Not quite asking directly — fishing for information in a way that sounds offhand. Genuinely interested but playing it cool.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、さぁ、もう授業始まるぞ
lines.en: Anyway, class is starting. We should get moving.
lines.style: Practical shift in energy. Brisk but not unkind. A return to normal rhythm after the back-and-forth. Standing up, gathering things. Moving on.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お年玉、まだたまるの?桜
lines.en: Do you still get New Year money from your family, or has that stopped already?
lines.style: Genuine question underneath the casualness. Softer than before — less performance. Real curiosity about something small in her life. Still cool on the surface, but the question lands warmly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の妹さん、珠のような瞳だな
lines.en: Your little sister has beautiful eyes, you know. Like pearls.
lines.style: Tender admission slipping through. Quiet and direct. No irony. A real compliment wrapped in simple words. Slight vulnerability in saying something genuine. Brief, not held.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うめぼし、美味しいよね。お前のお弁当の梅、すっぱそうだぜ、桜
lines.en: Pickled plums are good, but yours look way too sour. You're going to regret that.
lines.style: Warm teasing with genuine care underneath. Familiar and easy. The tone of someone noticing small details about her life. Light laugh in the delivery. Not mocking — just the comfortable ribbing of people who know each other.
